product_metadata.title: CafePress Vintage Halloween Witch Black Cat Decorative Fabric Shower Curtain
features: DRESS UP YOUR BATHROOM: Make shower time fun with this shower curtain that shows off your unique personality.

FUN AND FUNCTIONAL: Our standard-size high-quality shower curtain measures 70" x 72" and is the perfect choice to add some whimsy bathroom décor. Shower rod, rings and waterproof liner are not included.

PROFESSIONALLY PRINTED: Expertly printed with vivid designs using premium inks that resist fading. (Final design may slightly differ from what appears on screen.) Imported for final manufacture locally.

MADE TO LAST: Our high-quality shower is made from 100% softened polyester and features 12 buttonhole stich-enforced eyelets. To care for your shower curtain, machine wash cold on the delicate cycle and tumble dry low. Do not bleach, iron or dry clean.

IDEAL FOR YOUR HOME & A UNIQUE GIFT: Treat yourself or surprise friends and family with a fun shower curtain made just for them. Our shower curtain makes a unique and thoughtful housewarming gift and is perfect for Christmas or just because!
description: These high-quality shower curtain measures 70" x 72" and make great house warming gifts, and are a great gift for women, men, boys, and girls or a luxurious indulgence for yourself.
